page.overview:
What is Heliogabalus?

Heliogabalus is a warship in Final Fantasy Dimensions. It is the Avalon's ultimate weapon and Argy was supposed to be its heart. While not being operated, it is docked in a secret location under Fabrica Cave.

The Warriors of Light discovered Heliogabalus when they explored Fabrica Cave. Sol assumes this is a warship due to its size. The team decides to bring it down. The doors to access further into the warship were blocked so Sol bashed one, triggering the alarm. The Warriors were attacked by soldiers but they defeated them. Going through many floors and mechanical systems, they made it to the Engine Room. Cid and Dr. Lugae were inside, Cid telling Dr. Lugae that somebody was coming and he would be reunited with his daughter soon.

The warriors, along with Argy, entered the room. Dr. Lugae called Argy but she did not recognize him. Cid revealed that Sarah was the second princess of Burtgang. Cid took control of Argy who mindlessly fought the Warriors, but regained consciousness and became unaffected by Cid's controls. Argy attacked Cid, who realized that Argy had developed feelings. He actived Argy-2 to attack the team. Argy and her counterpart clashed, but Argy-2 gained the advantage. The team, along with Argy, defeated Argy-2, but Cid escaped during the fight.

Argy was badly damaged. She recognized Dr. Lugae as her father and thanked Sol and Sarah for bringing her back to him. Argy's soul turned into a crystal and gave the Warriors Memorist power. The ship malfunctioned and began to explode.
